author: Minimal-junkie

title: Clean and simple but
body:
It is a nice app however if you are debating between this and free alternatives, the free one might be better.

First, the widget only refreshes after the app is opened (so in the morning it does not display your to do’s immediately).

Second, things added to your Things calendar are not added to your apple calendar (they should add a feature to enable this in some way).

Third, if you buy it on the phone, you still have to buy it again for you laptop (55 euros!)

Definitely needs improvement and 55 euros is ridiculous for such a simple app.
author: mels v. rheenen

title: Very useful
body:
Thank you for this app—it’s really handy.

I have one suggestion: sometimes I have multiple to-dos that belong together, but they don’t necessarily warrant creating a full project yet. It would be great if there were a way to group related to-dos by simply dragging one to-do underneath another, without turning them into a project.

I’d find that feature really useful.
author: HermanThom

title: Today vs Upcoming
body:
How come "today" is not included in Upcoming?

If I want to re-schedule Today's tasks, I have to jump back and forth between the two views.

Could you please add an option to display it together?

body:

title: Best TODO app ever
body: A TODO app should have as little friction as possible getting a TODO on your list. Things achieves that through shortcuts and action buttons that make adding a TODO one click or keypress away. body: After the iOS update, the placement of the check mark after setting a time is not in a good place for me. Feels not intuitive anymore this way.
author: B. B...

title: Things wins
body: A while ago I wrote here that Apple’s own Reminders app could now do everything Things does. I take that back. After receiving a gracious reply from the developers, I gave Things another try (which was easy enough because Things can import most items from Reminders), and it *does* offer more. One gripe is that it lacks dependencies (tasks remaining hidden in the Today, Upcoming and Someday views until some specified other task had been completed), but Reminders doesn’t have that, either. Maybe in a future version? That would rock. Regardless, this is a five star app as it is.

title: Not my Thing(s)
body:
There's a lot this app does right. It's sleek looking and is fast to use. There are a couple of dealbreakers for me:
* no way to create views for your tasks within the app. If you want to view anytime and work together you have to manually select that every time, or use an another app that allows for shortcuts.
* task titles get shortened just to save space
* fidgety: manually sorting tasks and moving them to this evening. It doesn't save the preferences.

title: Location based reminders and collaboration are lacking
body:
Things 3 is a absolutely gorgeous app. The UX is very refined and well thought out. E.g. the display of your day calendar above your tasks is very handy as is the pull search and drag nerd task. 
I would love to start using Things on a daily basis but the lack of location based reminders and collaboration is holding me back. I use these a lot in Todoist and without them I just can’t make the switch. So eagerly awaiting these additions.

author: burpke

title: Things 3
body:
An absolutely beautifully designed task manager app. I’ve used virtually every task manager under the sun but this is the one that just works for me. 

The way the app is structured (upcoming, anytime, someday) makes it perfect for handling everything from quick tasks to entire projects. To stay on track you can also see your iCloud agenda items next to your tasks for better planning. Overall this app just oozes productivity.

author: matsko_

title: notifications disappear from lockscreen 😩
body:
I love this app, I really do. But what I REALLY REALLY need (as in: NEED) is for notifications to stay visible on my lock screen. If they don’t, what’s the point of setting a notification anyway? I’ve already missed a few medication intakes because of this supposed functionality.

I don’t want to use two apps for reminders (Apple’s native reminder app does in fact keep the notifications on the lock screen), I want it all in this one app that I paid 11 euros for 😭

Please fix this. It’s just a small tiny thing that I believe will help many people and I really think this should be part of a premium to do app like Things. Thanks in advance!

body:

Checklists niet handig als boodschappenlijst want je gaat te snel naar het 'edit' scherm om de tekst aan te passen ipv afvinken. Daarnaast is de app niet vergelijkbaar met Todoist, AnyDo of 2Do. Delen van webpagina's, toevoegen van documenten of doorsturen van mail, niet mogelijk!

Wees je ervan bewust dat bij deze app geen 14dagen niet goed geld terug garantie zit! Gekocht en niet tevreden = vette pech!
author: M4thij5

title: Things 3 is making me work
body: I like to work with GTD method and Things 3 is the solution for me. I used Trello before, but it doesn't have the focus that Things has for me. I hope that the Culture Code team keeps bringing us new features in the future!
author: Bart Engels

title: Uitstekende app
body: Alleen jammer dat je niet zonder (veel) extra te betalen de iPad en Mac variant kunt gebruiken.
author: KingEijb

title: Doet wat ie moet doen
body: Al jaren een trouwe metgezel die keurig doet wat hij moet doen. Update is oké; of de interface beter is is een kwestie van smaak maar de features zijn uitstekend.
author: Frank Kresin

title: Great app, but I'm missing a few things
body:
Correct me if I'm wrong, but there's no Geofence reminders. I'd like to be reminded to do Things when I arrive somewhere.

Also I've noticed that scheduled reminders don't always send notifications. They just pop up in the Today page.
author: IsThatSteven

title: Beautiful update
body: So much care is given to every detail.
author: Roel Smelt

title: Things does it again
body: The best app for keeping track of your busy life!
author: ptrschtn

title: Prachtig
body: En handig!
author: Marsel.nl

title: Things vs Swipes
body: Ben deze even gaan gebruiken voor de verandering. Bevalt me net zo goed als swipes.
author: Troelstra 1

title: Awesome productivity app
body: Easy to use and user friendly. Keep up the good work guys!
author: Mishavb

title: Zeer tevreden
body: Fijn werkende en overzichtelijke app. Doet wat het moet doen!
author: Abbedeus

title: De to-do app voor mij
body: Overzichtelijke to-do app met krachtige functies! Sluit perfect aan op de GTD methode
author: RonS63

title: Have been using since version 1, now developers have outdone themselves
body:
Great release, love it, now with the integration with the calendar and reminders fantastical is no longer that important. 
Congrats, you're an inspiration.!
author: robertgeifman

title: New version with a better look & workflow
body:
A rediscovery of Things. I like the new workflow and look. 

Nonetheless, I would like new functions such as: email to Things & one universal app for iPhone and iPad.
author: R0lfF

title: Beautiful application
body:
One of my favorite apps the new design and delightful animations are subtle but really nice! 
I have tried many productivity apps but this is the only one that really works for my brain :-)
author: druchtie

title: Heerlijke app
body:
Heerlijke app. Hoogstandje wat design en user experience betreft. Dus ga je het veel gebruiken, want het werkt fijn.

Synchroniseren met andere apparaten werkt ook goed. Enige nadeel is dat de OSX versie wel erg prijzig is.
author: Frank (NL)

title: Excellent
body: Things 3 is very good, and definitely worth the money to upgrade. Almost all changes are subtle, yet improve the app. Well done!
author: foow

title: Exactly what I want in a ToDo app
body: This is all I ever wanted from a ToDo app. I've just added every task I have to complete for my graduation research, and this is the first task manager that actually helped me instead of slowing the process down. It has the exact amount of nesting that I need without making the task unclear.
author: Manuelspaan

title: It's finally here :)
body:
Back in 2014, after using the Mac version for more than 4 years Things for the iPhone was the reason I bought the iPhone in the first place. 
Now, after all these years of waiting Things 3 is finally here! When I received the email that it came out I started screaming like a little girl and cleared the rest of my afternoon; it was more than Christmas.
It's clear from the get go the team really listened to its users and created something really great. My entire (OCD) life revolves around this app, without it I don't know what I would do, I HIGHLY recommend it.
author: Rstepa

title: Simpel en mooi
body: Tussen alle tools die ik graag gebruik blijft deze overeind. Ik vind hem wel duur omdat je hem moet kopen voor al je verschillende devices. Verder perfect!
author: ES!@#

title: Simple and beautiful!
body: I wish the team behind this had more transparency in communications.
author: ashkrosh

title: Awesome but could be even better
body: Awesome taskmanager, even though I'd like some extra features. I wish it had a collaboration feature and the possibility to order tags in project view.
author: Mitchellvs

title: Great update!
body: Everything that lacked is now in place!
author: Mike Bear

title: Metvlagenwimple
body: Ik ben om, echt een TOP app!
author: metvlagenwimpel

title: THINGS
body: Response to the developers: I know I have to tap the ... button. But please do me one favor: explain on this "blog" step by step to enter a message and add a reminder with an alert every two weeks on Thursday to that message.
author: Polkje

title: Mooi en handig.
body:
Gebruik Things al jaren voor alles wat in mijn hoofd zit en onthouden of gepland moet worden. 
Het ziet er met v3 nu mooier uit, vooral de checklist en de integratie met kalender, Siri en herinneringen bevalt me goed.
Meest gebruikte app op mijn iPhone.
author: A25BYSG43

title: Slick app well worth the money
body: Things 3 looks good and works well. For me, the ease with which it allows me to focus on the tasks for the day is the killer function.
author: Accolade

title: Don't hesitate
body:
Things 3 is amazing. Great upgrade and more than worth it.
Just what I need, easy to use, interface is easy on the eyes but effective and no useless functions.

I would however very much like to have the ability to add attachments! So no 5 but 4 stars.
author: thvanderwal

title: (Almost) Perfect!
body: Love the new v3. I used Things2 for a few years as a 90% happy user but v3 introduces exactly what I was missing: a quick view of both my scheduled actions and my calendar on that date. Very handy! Plus a major improvement in design.... I'm at 99% now😃 Integration with time-tracking (eg. Toggl) and filing/reference (eg. Evernote) would have me at 100% for sure.
author: JervisNL

title: Amazing productivity tool
body: Things is esthetically pleasing app that makes you want to put thoughts to the app. Even though there are many todos that have tons of features, Things beats all of them with perfected quality. It's worth the money!
author: dsholkov

title: Simply the best
body: Top design, most user friendly, very reliable. Value for money.
author: Appelgebakmetslagroom

title: Great new version
body: This new version makes the already great productivity app that Things was now even better. I like the new option for calender integration.
author: Ordonnans

title: Super!
body: Lange tijd gewacht op deze release, helemaal te gek!
author: vmbrouwer

title: Upgrade meer dan waard!
body:
Ben al jaren een gebruiker van Things (2) op IPhone, iPad en MacBook. Vond het de fijnste to do app, schone interface ... en toch viel ik af en toe terug op Evernote voor mijn ToDo's, ik miste blijkbaar toch iets.
De nieuwe Things 3 gedownload voor al mijn apparaten - een feest!
Nieuwe interface nog veel prettiger dan de oude. Ook de extra features zijn erg prettig. GTD is direct sneller, mooier en prettiger. Is de upgrade meer dan waard!!
author: Bilthoven 888

title: Eén woord: top!
body: Al jaren gebruik ik 'Things', maar deze versie is ongekend handig en goed!
author: Jajutka

title: Nog beter dan Things 2
body: Ziet er mooier uit en heeft veel kleine en grote nuttige verbeteringen. Wel duur als je het voor iPhone, iPad en Mac koopt, maar ook een fantastische app.
author: pmmueller

title: Stop reading and get this app, also on Mac
body: Simply the best
author: Joostdekruijff

title: Speechless...
body: Things had been my todo list for a long time and Cultured Code never has been a 'fast' group of people in churning out features but hey! NOW I understand. I'm speechless. Really. They really did it this time. Reduced the interface to the bare bones using all real estate there is AND they added some great features such as checklists. In one word: Wow. If you look for a single person GTD program this always has been the goto program but now there really isn't any other alternative worth considering.
author: Ruurd Pels

title: Stap in de juiste richting
body:
Versie 3 alweer en ziet er fantastisch uit. Interface werkt erg fijn en handig in gebruik. 
Wat ik mis is de mogelijkheid om reminders bepaalde dagen te doen ipv elke dag. (v.b. sporten op alleen maandag, woensdag en vrijdag)
Met huidige versie moet dit apart, dus driemaal, instellen. 
Verder is en werkt hij fantastisch.

[update] Reminders voor bepaalde dagen zit nu wel in.
author: R. Gruyters

title: Excellent update
body: Very good update with solid new features.
author: Jspr58963

title: Amazing
body: This is the todo/task app you ever searched for
author: Disparone

title: Super hulp bij het organiseren van al mijn taken en verplichtingen
body: Things 2 was al goed maar deze versie is nog beter!
author: Doerak

title: Great!
body: Awesome app; really happy with v3 after using v2 for many years. Deeper calendar integration (allocate to do's to free time) and time tracking would really make Things the holy grail in task management for me.
author: Robarley

title: Powerful, easy, and beautiful
body: Things is an integral part of what I do, and I couldn't guess how they could improve it. It's now even more powerful, even easier to use, and it's gorgeous all at the same time. It actually makes organizing your days a pleasure. Well done!
author: transferorbit

title: Goede nieuwe release!
body: Veel functionele verbeteringen en ziet er weer mooier uit.
author: Jerome B.

title: Fantastisch
body: Prachtig ontwerp. Heeft precies de extras waar ik op hoopte. Enige wat ik nog mis is de mogelijkheid om samen te werken in Things.
author: Gerke Roorda

title: My Todo app
body:
Things was the first of many todo apps I used on my iPad, and, to be honest, one of the more expensive (especially if you want to use it on your watch, iPhone, iPad and mac) and least feature rich. 
Yet I returned to Things every time. I really love using the Today screen and the ease of checking tasks on the watch. And the features it does have are very well designed in my opinion. 
There were some features I missed, and some ways of doing things that I needed to work around. 
In Things 3 every issue I might have had has disappeared.

It is the Todo app for me, and frankly, it has always been.
author: RuudTh

title: Good design
body: Perfect app, good design. Love the headings and projects.
author: S.janssen

title: Heel goed
body: Ziet er prachtig uit en is bijzonder slim ontworpen. Biedt veel functionaliteit, zonder onaangenaam complex te worden.
author: Rivaldus2

title: Perfect to-do app
body: I've tried dozens of different apps and this is the only I *really* like. Such a great product.
